title: Alumni Meet 2026

sections.heading: Alumni Meet 2026
sections.content:
Greetings from ABMSP’s APCOER, Pune!!!
It’s always been a pleasure to have continued ties with you. Hope you are doing well in your Profession. We are sure that our distinguished graduates are contributing significantly to their organization and communities holding high standards and values in everything that they do.
To enhance bonding between Institute and Alumni, Institute is organizing Alumni Meet on 09.05.2026. You are cordially invited to attend a meeting and share your college and professional experience.
Details of Alumni Meet:
Day and Date: Saturday, May 09, 2026
Venue: Mechanical Seminar Hall, Departmental of Mechanical Engineering.
The meeting is followed by Lunch andGift.
Request you to fill the details on below google link:
https://forms.gle/d9vNHDDyhv7yZqJz5
You are our valued ambassador and we look forward to your continued association with ABMSP’s APCOER, Pune. We request you to convey your confirmation to the undersigned for better arrangements.
